_comment: NPR3 re-seeding ablation. baseline seed_search_NPR3 has ~1142 PyRosetta-passing founders across 98 fully-scored conditions -> directly usable (PyRosetta). target_len=415 is the CROPPED target length used in the prior runs (settings_used.target_length) = chain-A length of the founder complexes; raw NPR3.pdb is 541 aa.
